_note: Chapter 29 词汇卡内容。ipa = 音标; ex = 例句数组, 顺序与词表中该词出现的行序一致(多词性词给多个例句, 每个例句对应词性行); note = 用法提示/搭配。

ex.en: A good guide should accompany young visitors through the museum.
ex.cn: 一位好导游应当陪着年轻参观者走遍整座博物馆。
ex.note: accompany sb. to … 陪同某人去…；be accompanied by 伴随着

ex.en: The actual cost of the project was much higher than the estimate.
ex.cn: 这个项目的实际成本比估算高得多。
ex.note: in actual fact 事实上

ex.en: The heavy rain affected the quality of the tea leaves.
ex.cn: 大雨影响了茶叶的质量。
ex.note: affect the result 影响结果（名词是 effect）

ex.en: The old tree is still alive, though most of its branches are bare.
ex.cn: 这棵老树还活着，尽管大多数枝干都光秃秃的。
ex.note: be alive with 充满…；alive to 对…有意识的

ex.en: The children sang and danced in obvious amusement.
ex.cn: 孩子们显然乐在其中，唱着跳着。
ex.note: to one's amusement 令某人开心的是；a place of amusement 娱乐场所

ex.en: Is there anything else I can do for you?
ex.cn: 还有别的我能为你做的吗？
ex.note: anything but 根本不；nothing but 只不过

ex.en: The decision to close the road was completely arbitrary.
ex.cn: 封路的决定完全是凭主观随意作出的。
ex.note: an arbitrary decision 武断的决定

ex.en: It took the workers two days to assemble the new machine.
ex.cn: 工人们花了两天时间把这台新机器组装起来。
ex.note: assemble a team 组建团队；assemble at a place 集合

ex.en: The temple on the hill is the main tourist attraction of the area.
ex.cn: 山上的那座庙是这一带的主要旅游景点。
ex.note: an attraction for 对…有吸引力的事物

ex.en: The lab tests the water for bacteria twice a week.
ex.cn: 实验室每周两次检测水里的细菌。
ex.note: bacteria are 常用复数

ex.en: Curiosity is a basic skill that no one can really teach you.
ex.cn: 好奇心是一种谁也真正教不会你的基本能力。
ex.note: be basic to 对…至关重要

ex.en: Read the safety file beforehand before you go to the site.
ex.cn: 去工地之前，先把安全文件读一遍。
ex.note: beforehand = in advance 事先

ex.en: He had a bias toward evidence rather than speed.
ex.cn: 他看重的是证据，而不是速度。
ex.note: a bias against 对…的偏见；have a bias toward 偏爱

ex.en: By September the plant on the windowsill had begun to bloom.
ex.cn: 到了九月，窗台上的那株植物已经开始开花了。
ex.note: in full bloom 盛开；bloom into 发展成

ex.en: The ball bounced against the wall until the neighbor knocked.
ex.cn: 球在墙上弹来弹去，直到邻居来敲门。
ex.note: bounce back 弹回；反弹

ex.en: He kept a broken toy car in a drawer for years.
ex.cn: 他把一辆坏了的玩具车在抽屉里放了好几年。
ex.note: a broken promise 被违背的诺言

ex.en: He took a cab to the office and arrived forty minutes early.
ex.cn: 他打了辆出租车去公司，早到了四十分钟。
ex.note: take a cab 打车；call a cab 叫出租车

ex.en: She joined a literary club in the capital last spring.
ex.cn: 去年春天，她在首都参加了一个文学社。
ex.note: capital city 首都；capital letter 大写字母

ex.en: The project was of capital importance to the whole valley.
ex.cn: 这个项目对整条山谷都至关重要。
ex.note: of capital importance 极其重要；capital punishment 死刑

ex.en: They drove for three hours, past wide fields of cattle.
ex.cn: 他们开了三个小时的车，驶过一片片宽阔的牧场。
ex.note: cattle 指“牛群”时用复数形式

ex.en: The engineer changed the design when a pipe would not fit.
ex.cn: 当管道装不上时，工程师改了设计。
ex.note: change one's mind 改变主意；change trains 换乘

ex.en: The water level showed a marked change after the storm.
ex.cn: 风暴过后，水位出现了明显的变化。
ex.note: make a change 做出改变；for a change 换换口味

ex.en: He kept his childhood in a drawer, together with a wooden doll.
ex.cn: 他把童年收在一个抽屉里，和一个木娃娃放在一起。
ex.note: in one's childhood 在某人小时候

ex.en: They watched a classic film about the last emperor of a dynasty.
ex.cn: 他们看了一部关于一个王朝末代皇帝的经典影片。
ex.note: a classic example 典型的例子

ex.en: That old novel is a classic that everyone in the office has read.
ex.cn: 那部旧小说是一部名著，办公室里人人都读过。
ex.note: a classic of … …的经典作品

ex.en: That village still burns coal for heat in winter.
ex.cn: 那个村子冬天仍然烧煤取暖。
ex.note: coal gas 煤气；dig for coal 挖煤

ex.en: Her only comment on the report was that he should name the inspector.
ex.cn: 她对报告只提了一条意见：应该写上检查员的名字。
ex.note: make a comment on/about 对…发表评论

ex.en: Several engineers commented on the new plan before it was approved.
ex.cn: 新方案批准之前，几位工程师对它发表了意见。
ex.note: comment on sth. 对某事发表评论

ex.en: Each part of the pump is a small component of the whole system.
ex.cn: 水泵的每个部件都是整个系统的一小块。
ex.note: a key component 关键部件

ex.en: The praise gave him a tremendous amount of confidence.
ex.cn: 这番夸奖给了他莫大的信心。
ex.note: in confidence 秘密地；have confidence in 对…有信心

ex.en: A man of a strong constitution can stand the cold all night.
ex.cn: 身体底子好的人，能在寒夜里站上一整晚。
ex.note: the constitution 宪法；a strong constitution 强健的体质

ex.en: The design was conventional, but its scale was larger than anything he had seen.
ex.cn: 这个设计相当常规，可它的规模却比他见过的任何工程都大。
ex.note: conventional wisdom 传统观念

ex.en: He had a bad cough and stayed at home for a week.
ex.cn: 他咳嗽得厉害，在家待了一个星期。
ex.note: a bad cough 咳嗽得厉害；cough up 咳出

ex.en: She gave him credit for noticing the error first.
ex.cn: 她称赞他第一个发现了这个错误。
ex.note: give sb. credit for 因…而赞扬某人；credit card 信用卡

ex.en: He credited his success to patience and good advice.
ex.cn: 他把自己的成功归功于耐心和别人的指点。
ex.note: credit A to B 把 A 归功于 B

ex.en: The young engineer was curious about every part of the machine.
ex.cn: 这位年轻工程师对机器的每个部件都很好奇。
ex.note: be curious about 对…好奇；a curious smell 奇怪的气味

ex.en: One of her twin daughters wanted to be a doctor.
ex.cn: 她的双胞胎女儿中有一个想当医生。
ex.note: only daughter 独女

ex.en: The reservoir was deep and quiet under the hill.
ex.cn: 山谷下的水库又深又静。
ex.note: deep in thought 陷入沉思；a deep impression 深刻的印象

ex.en: He dug deep into the story and found a small error.
ex.cn: 他深入地查看了这份报告，发现了一处小错误。
ex.note: deep into 深入…；dig deep 深入钻研

ex.en: The whole valley depends on this reservoir for water.
ex.cn: 整条山谷都靠这座水库供水。
ex.note: depend on 依靠；it depends 那要看情况

ex.en: The development of the valley depended on the new reservoir.
ex.cn: 山谷的开发取决于这座新水库。
ex.note: economic development 经济发展；a housing development 住宅开发区

ex.en: In a dry summer the water level would dip by a meter.
ex.cn: 在干旱的夏天，水位会下降一米。
ex.note: dip into 伸进…里；dip briefly 短暂下降

ex.en: There was a sharp dip in sales during the hot summer.
ex.cn: 炎热的夏季，销量出现了一次急剧下滑。
ex.note: a dip in … …的下降

ex.en: David did not dislike these Friday evenings at all.
ex.cn: 大卫一点也不讨厌这样的周五夜晚。
ex.note: dislike doing 讨厌做；a dislike of 对…的厌恶

ex.en: His grandmother had carved a wooden doll for him as a child.
ex.cn: 小时候，祖母给他刻了一个木娃娃。
ex.note: a doll's house 玩偶小屋

ex.en: He kept his childhood things in a drawer under the bed.
ex.cn: 他把童年的东西放在床下的抽屉里。
ex.note: a chest of drawers 五斗柜

ex.en: The film tells the story of a dynasty and its last emperor.
ex.cn: 这部电影讲的是一个王朝和它最后一位皇帝的故事。
ex.note: a wealthy dynasty 显赫的家族

ex.en: The drawing on the board was an effective answer to the question.
ex.cn: 黑板上的那张草图有效地回答了那个问题。
ex.note: take effective action 采取有效措施；come into effect 生效

ex.en: A small error in the report could embarrass the whole department.
ex.cn: 报告里的一个小错误，就可能让整个部门下不来台。
ex.note: embarrass sb. 使某人尴尬

ex.en: A new engine was installed in the pump house last spring.
ex.cn: 去年春天，泵房里装上了新机组。
ex.note: steam engine 蒸汽机；engine room 机房

ex.en: A new steel pipe was erected beside the old dam.
ex.cn: 一根新的钢管在旧坝旁边竖了起来。
ex.note: erect a monument 立纪念碑

ex.en: The workers stood erect in the freezing wind.
ex.cn: 工人们笔直地站在刺骨的寒风里。
ex.note: erect posture 挺直的姿势

ex.en: Tell me exactly what the client said about the cost.
ex.cn: 告诉我客户关于成本究竟是怎么说的。
ex.note: not exactly 不完全是；exactly speaking 确切地说

ex.en: Travel and hotel costs are counted as official expenses.
ex.cn: 差旅和住宿费用都算作公的开支。
ex.note: at the expense of 以…为代价；expense report 报销单

ex.en: Weather is the one factor no project manager can control.
ex.cn: 天气是项目经理唯一无法控制的因素。
ex.note: a key factor 关键因素

ex.en: She wore a jacket in the latest fashion, chosen by her daughters.
ex.cn: 她穿着一件女儿挑选的时髦外套。
ex.note: in fashion 流行的；the fashion of doing 做某事的方式

ex.en: The soil along the river is fertile, and farmers grow vegetables there.
ex.cn: 河边的土地很肥沃，农民在那里种蔬菜。
ex.note: fertile land 沃土；a fertile mind 活跃的头脑

ex.en: His first project was a reservoir in the hills.
ex.cn: 他的第一个项目是山里的一座水库。
ex.note: the first time 第一次；first of all 首先

ex.en: First read the safety file, then go to the site.
ex.cn: 先读安全文件，然后再去工地。
ex.note: first of all 首先；to begin with 起初

ex.en: Thick fog covered the road up the hill for most of the morning.
ex.cn: 整个上午，大雾都笼罩着上山的路。
ex.note: foggy 雾蒙蒙的；a fog of war 战争迷雾

ex.en: The old man walked forth and greeted the workers warmly.
ex.cn: 老人走上前，热情地跟工人们打招呼。
ex.note: back and forth 来来回回；and so forth 等等

ex.en: The chairman's letter came from an organization abroad.
ex.cn: 主席的来信来自一家海外机构。
ex.note: from time to time 时不时；from then on 从那以后

ex.en: They searched the fence for a gap wide enough to get through.
ex.cn: 他们沿着围栏找一道足够宽的缺口。
ex.note: a gap between … …之间的差距；bridge the gap 弥合差距

ex.en: His mother sent him a gift when the lease was signed.
ex.cn: 签下租约那天，母亲寄给他一件礼物。
ex.note: a gift for languages 语言天赋

ex.en: The government pushed the schedule forward by three months.
ex.cn: 政府把工期提前了三个月。
ex.note: local government 地方政府；under government control 在政府控制之下

ex.en: The girl at the desk gave him a warm greeting.
ex.cn: 前台的姑娘给了他一个热情的招呼。
ex.note: a greeting card 贺卡；greet sb. with … 用…迎接某人

ex.en: The building has a glass hall and a security desk at the entrance.
ex.cn: 这栋楼有一个玻璃门厅，入口处还设着安保台。
ex.note: a lecture hall 阶梯教室；go through the hall 走过大厅

ex.en: The warning sign points to a serious hazard on the construction site.
ex.cn: 警示牌指向工地上一个严重的危险源。
ex.note: a health hazard 健康危害；hazard warning 危险警告

ex.en: He kept a pot of herbs on the windowsill.
ex.cn: 他在窗台上养了一盆香草。
ex.note: herbal tea 花草茶；medicinal herbs 药草

ex.en: The little temple on the summit was a holy place for the villagers.
ex.cn: 山顶上那座小庙，是村民心中的圣地。
ex.note: a holy place 圣地；holy water 圣水

ex.en: Show me how the new pump is put together.
ex.cn: 给我看看这台新水泵是怎么组装起来的。
ex.note: how long 多久；how many 多少

ex.en: Do not ignore the boring pages; that is where mistakes hide.
ex.cn: 别跳过那些枯燥的页面，错误就藏在那里。
ex.note: ignore sb./sth. 忽视某人/某事

ex.en: His English improved a great deal in his first year at work.
ex.cn: 工作的第一年里，他的英语进步很大。
ex.note: improve on/upon 胜过；improve one's chances 增加机会

ex.en: He felt that his work might have infinite possibilities.
ex.cn: 他觉得自己的工作也许有着无限的可能。
ex.note: infinite possibilities 无限可能；the infinite 无限

ex.en: The engineer did not give an instant answer.
ex.cn: 工程师没有立刻给出回答。
ex.note: instant noodles 方便面；in an instant 转眼之间

ex.en: For an instant he could not remember the procedure.
ex.cn: 有那么一瞬间，他竟想不起该怎么做。
ex.note: for an instant 片刻；at the first instant 起初片刻

ex.en: He had to report the pressure at every interval of five minutes.
ex.cn: 他必须每隔五分钟报告一次压力。
ex.note: at intervals 每隔一会儿；a short interval 短暂的间隔

ex.en: She had a strong jaw and a straight nose.
ex.cn: 她下颌方正，鼻子笔直。
ex.note: the upper/lower jaw 上/下颌

ex.en: He kept the old photos in a wooden box on the shelf.
ex.cn: 他把那些旧照片保存在架子上的木盒里。
ex.note: keep sth. for sb. 为某人留着；keep doing 坚持做

ex.en: Mark's letters began to lag, and David did not blame him.
ex.cn: 马克的回信开始拖得越来越晚，大卫并没有怪他。
ex.note: lag behind 落后于；a time lag 时间滞后

ex.en: Mr. Gu led the team through every stage of the project.
ex.cn: 顾先生带领团队走完了项目的每一个阶段。
ex.note: lead to 导致；lead sb. to do 带某人做

ex.en: Test the pipe for lead before you drink the water.
ex.cn: 喝水之前先检测管道里有没有铅。
ex.note: lead pipes 含铅的管道；in the lead 领先

ex.en: Sarah's letters were full of languages and nationalities.
ex.cn: 萨拉的来信里满是各种语言和各种各样的国籍。
ex.note: an official letter 公函；the letter A 字母A

ex.en: She joined a literary club in the capital and read a lot of poetry.
ex.cn: 她在首都参加了一个文学社，读了很多诗。
ex.note: literary works 文学作品；literary style 文风

ex.en: There was a lot of traffic on the road that morning.
ex.cn: 那天早上，路上车很多。
ex.note: a lot of 许多；lots of 大量；draw lots 抽签

ex.en: The firm maintains water systems for the city and the surrounding towns.
ex.cn: 这家公司为这座城市和周边几个镇维护供水系统。
ex.note: maintain a balance 保持平衡；maintain that 坚持认为

ex.en: Every great master of water engineering began as a beginner.
ex.cn: 每一位水利工程的大师都曾是个新手。
ex.note: a master of … …的大师；master's degree 硕士学位

ex.en: You will never master everything, but you can master the habit of listening.
ex.cn: 你永远不会精通一切，但你可以精通倾听的习惯。
ex.note: master a language 掌握一门语言

ex.en: His first meeting was with the oldest engineer in the office.
ex.cn: 他的第一次会议，对面是办公室里资历最老的工程师。
ex.note: hold a meeting 开会；at the meeting 在会上

ex.en: Half the measurements on the old drawings were in millimeters.
ex.cn: 旧图纸上一半的尺寸用的是毫米。
ex.note: one millimeter = 1 mm 毫米

ex.en: The designer modified the plan when a pipe would not fit.
ex.cn: 管道装不上时，设计人员修改了方案。
ex.note: modify a design 修改设计

ex.en: When she talked, her whole mouth moved.
ex.cn: 她一说话，整张嘴都在动。
ex.note: by mouth 口头；the mouth of a river 河口

ex.en: The club has members of more than twenty nationalities.
ex.cn: 这个俱乐部有二十多个国籍的成员。
ex.note: dual nationality 双重国籍

ex.en: He never regretted the day he took the job.
ex.cn: 他从不后悔接受那份工作的那一天。
ex.note: never mind 没关系；never have I seen 从未见过

ex.en: She had a strong jaw and a straight nose.
ex.cn: 她下颌方正，鼻子笔直。
ex.note: a sharp nose 敏锐的嗅觉；under one's nose 当着某人的面

ex.en: She was a careful observer of the young engineers under her.
ex.cn: 她是手下这些年轻工程师的细心观察者。
ex.note: a keen observer 敏锐的观察者

ex.en: One of her daughters wanted to be a doctor.
ex.cn: 她的一个女儿想当医生。
ex.note: one of … …之一；one day 有一天

ex.en: She works for an organization that helps refugees.
ex.cn: 她供职于一个帮助难民的机构。
ex.note: a non-profit organization 非营利组织

ex.en: Sarah has lived overseas for two years.
ex.cn: 萨拉已经在海外住了两年。
ex.note: go overseas 出国；overseas students 海外学生

ex.en: A parade of fire engines passed the house at midnight.
ex.cn: 午夜时分，一队消防车列队驶过房子前。
ex.note: a military parade 阅兵式；a parade of 一连串

ex.en: Thousands of students paraded through the main street.
ex.cn: 成千上万的学生列队穿过主街。
ex.note: parade sth. before sb. 向某人炫耀某物

ex.en: The nurse told the patient to rest for two weeks.
ex.cn: 护士让病人休息两个星期。
ex.note: a heart patient 心脏病人

ex.en: His supervisor was a patient woman who read every report twice.
ex.cn: 他的上司是个有耐心的女人，每份报告都要看两遍。
ex.note: be patient with sb. 对某人耐心；patient waiting 耐心等待

ex.en: She wore a different perfume every Friday.
ex.cn: 她每个周五换一种香水。
ex.note: a bottle of perfume 一瓶香水；the perfume of roses 玫瑰的香气

ex.en: He picked a leaf from the herbs on the windowsill.
ex.cn: 他从窗台上的香草里摘下一片叶子。
ex.note: pick up 捡起；pick a time 挑时间

ex.en: The city is the pick of the coastal resorts.
ex.cn: 这座城市是海岸度假地中的首选。
ex.note: the pick of the bunch 出类拔萃者

ex.en: The building stood right beside the playground.
ex.cn: 这栋楼就紧挨着操场。
ex.note: a children's playground 儿童游乐场

ex.en: They tested the water for bacteria and pollution.
ex.cn: 他们检测了水里的细菌和污染。
ex.note: air pollution 空气污染；environmental pollution 环境污染

ex.en: The young engineer had real potential in design work.
ex.cn: 这个年轻工程师在设计工作上很有潜力。
ex.note: potential customers 潜在客户；potential risk 潜在风险

ex.en: She saw the potential in the idea and pushed it through the office.
ex.cn: 她看出了这个想法的可能性，并推动它在办公室里通过了。
ex.note: the potential for … …的可能性

ex.en: The client's engineer pressed him on one point of the design.
ex.cn: 客户的工程师就设计中的一个点追问大卫。
ex.note: press sb. for an answer 催某人给答复；press on 继续努力

ex.en: The story was reported by the local press that evening.
ex.cn: 那天晚上，这件事由当地媒体报道了出来。
ex.note: the press 新闻界；press conference 记者发布会

ex.en: Once the drawings were approved, the team could proceed.
ex.cn: 图纸一获批准，团队就可以开工了。
ex.note: proceed to do 着手做；proceed with 继续进行

ex.en: The engineers promised the village that the old temple would be under their protection.
ex.cn: 工程师们向村民保证，那座老庙将受到他们的保护。
ex.note: protection against 对…的保护；under the protection of 在…保护之下

ex.en: The government pushed the schedule forward to save money.
ex.cn: 政府把工期提前，为的是省钱。
ex.note: push sb. to do 催促某人做；push on 继续努力

ex.en: With one last push, the team finished the dam before the rains.
ex.cn: 经过最后一番冲刺，团队在雨季前完成了大坝。
ex.note: a big push 巨大的推动；at a push 勉强

ex.en: At every Friday dinner, the oldest engineer raised the first toast.
ex.cn: 每个周五的聚餐上，资历最老的工程师都会第一个举杯。
ex.note: raise a question 提出问题；raise money 筹钱

ex.en: He recalled the first day of the job and the warm greeting he received.
ex.cn: 他回想起上班的第一天，以及自己收到的那句热情的招呼。
ex.note: recall doing 记得做过；recall sb. to do 召某人做

ex.en: His refusal to sign the faulty report cost the team two days.
ex.cn: 他拒绝在有问题的报告上签字，让团队损失了两天。
ex.note: a refusal to do 拒绝做；meet with refusal 遭到拒绝

ex.en: Her first honest remark about the job made him laugh.
ex.cn: 她对这份工作的第一句实在话逗笑了他。
ex.note: make a remark 发表评论

ex.en: She remarked that the drawing was clear enough to understand.
ex.cn: 她说这张图足够清楚，一看就懂。
ex.note: remark on/upon 对…发表评论

ex.en: The new reservoir will supply three small towns.
ex.cn: 这座新水库将供给三个小镇。
ex.note: a water reservoir 蓄水池

ex.en: He revised the report that afternoon and handed it back.
ex.cn: 那天下午他改了报告，把它交了回去。
ex.note: revise a report 修改报告；revise for exams 复习备考

ex.en: He rolled the old report into a tube and threw it away.
ex.cn: 他把旧报告卷成一卷，扔进了垃圾桶。
ex.note: roll up 卷起；roll along 继续前进

ex.en: The teacher called the roll before the lesson began.
ex.cn: 上课前老师点了名。
ex.note: call the roll 点名；a roll of film 一卷胶片

ex.en: There were days when the work made him sad.
ex.cn: 有些日子，工作让他很难过。
ex.note: be sad about 为…感到难过；a sad mistake 令人遗憾的错误

ex.en: The scale of the project was larger than anything he had seen at university.
ex.cn: 这个项目的规模比他在大学里见过的任何工程都大。
ex.note: on a large scale 大规模地；a pair of scales 一架天平

ex.en: The team scaled the steep slope to reach the dam site.
ex.cn: 团队攀登陡坡，抵达大坝工地。
ex.note: scale the walls 攀上墙头；scale up 扩大规模

ex.en: They searched the shoreline for a gap in the fence.
ex.cn: 他们沿着岸线寻找围栏的缺口。
ex.note: search for 寻找；in search of 寻找

ex.en: He wrote a sentence in the report that was not true.
ex.cn: 他在报告里写了一句不实的话。
ex.note: serve a sentence 服刑；a death sentence 死刑判决

ex.en: The judge sentenced the thief to two years in prison.
ex.cn: 法官判那个小偷两年监禁。
ex.note: sentence sb. to … 判某人…

ex.en: Liu's husband had shaved his head, and the office never got tired of the joke.
ex.cn: 刘的丈夫剃了光头，办公室里的人怎么也笑不够这个笑话。
ex.note: shave off 剃掉；shave a beard 刮胡子

ex.en: He shut the drawer and sat down on the floor.
ex.cn: 他关上抽屉，在地板上坐了下来。
ex.note: shut off 切断；shut down 关闭（机器）

ex.en: The office sits between the river and the old market.
ex.cn: 办公室坐落在河与老市场之间。
ex.note: sit for an exam 参加考试；be situated 位于

ex.en: She wore a smart jacket in the latest fashion.
ex.cn: 她穿着一件最时髦的短外套。
ex.note: smart clothes 漂亮的衣服；smart phone 智能手机

ex.en: He solved the difficult question with a quick drawing on the board.
ex.cn: 他用黑板上的一张草图解决了一个难题。
ex.note: solve a problem 解决问题；solve for 求出

ex.en: He kept a spare room for storage and for visitors.
ex.cn: 他留了一间空房，可以堆杂物，也可以住人。
ex.note: a spare room 备用房间；spare time 空闲时间

ex.en: Could you spare an hour to help me read these drawings?
ex.cn: 你能抽出一个小时，帮我看看这些图纸吗？
ex.note: spare sb. sth. 抽出（时间/金钱）给某人；spare sb.'s life 饶某人一命

ex.en: Her spoken French is still terrible, but she can order coffee with confidence.
ex.cn: 她的法语口语仍然糟糕，却已经能自信地点咖啡了。
ex.note: spoken English 英语口语；spoken form 口头形式

ex.en: The report gives statistics on trains, coal and wages.
ex.cn: 这份报告给出了关于列车、煤炭和工资的统计数字。
ex.note: official statistics 官方统计；a statistical figure 统计数字

ex.en: A storm crossed the coast, and the water rose faster than expected.
ex.cn: 一场风暴掠过海岸，水位上涨得比预想的还快。
ex.note: a storm of protest 抗议的风潮；storm off 气冲冲地离开

ex.en: The stuff of a life, he thought, was mostly small.
ex.cn: 他想，一生的材料多半是很小的东西。
ex.note: the stuff of … …的素材；good stuff 好东西

ex.en: He stuffed the old letters back into the drawer.
ex.cn: 他把那些旧信塞回抽屉里。
ex.note: stuff sth. with 把…塞满…；stuff oneself 吃饱

ex.en: A small temple stood on the summit of the hill above the reservoir.
ex.cn: 水库上方那座小山的山顶上，立着一座小庙。
ex.note: at the summit of 在…顶部；a summit meeting 峰会

ex.en: I suspect the second page was never read.
ex.cn: 我怀疑第二页从来就没人看过。
ex.note: suspect sb. of sth. 怀疑某人做了某事

ex.en: The police questioned two suspects about the broken pipe.
ex.cn: 就那根断裂的管道，警察讯问了两名嫌疑人。
ex.note: prime suspect 主要嫌疑人

ex.en: The food was cheap and the talk was good, so the team stayed late.
ex.cn: 饭菜便宜，谈话投机，团队都待到很晚。
ex.note: talk about 谈论；give a talk 做个讲座

ex.en: The smell of the restaurant tempted him to stay another hour.
ex.cn: 饭馆的香味让他忍不住想再待上一小时。
ex.note: be tempted to do 忍不住做；tempt sb. into doing 引诱某人做

ex.en: He learned to explain the theoretical side to practical people.
ex.cn: 他学会了向务实的人讲清楚理论的那一面。
ex.note: theoretical knowledge 理论知识；in theory 理论上

ex.en: The new reservoir will supply three towns.
ex.cn: 这座新水库将供给三个镇。
ex.note: three times 三倍；in three days 三天后

ex.en: The oldest engineer raised the first toast at the yearly dinner.
ex.cn: 在年终聚餐上，资历最老的工程师第一个举杯。
ex.note: make a toast 祝酒；buttered toast 黄油吐司

ex.en: They toasted the new engineers at the end of the dinner.
ex.cn: 聚餐结束时，他们为新来的工程师们干了杯。
ex.note: toast sb. 为某人干杯；toast bread 烤面包

ex.en: A broken toy car lay at the bottom of the drawer.
ex.cn: 抽屉底下放着一辆坏了的玩具车。
ex.note: a toy for adults 成年人的玩意儿

ex.en: The praise gave him a tremendous amount of confidence.
ex.cn: 这番夸奖给了他莫大的信心。
ex.note: a tremendous amount of 大量的；tremendous progress 巨大的进步

ex.en: One of her twin daughters wanted to be a doctor.
ex.cn: 她的双胞胎女儿中有一个想当医生。
ex.note: twin sisters 一对孪生姐妹

ex.en: The twin towers stand side by side near the harbour.
ex.cn: 两座孪生塔楼并肩立在港口附近。
ex.note: twin brother/sister 孪生兄弟/姐妹；twin beds 两张单人床

ex.en: The union is negotiating with the government about wages.
ex.cn: 工会正在就工资问题与政府谈判。
ex.note: trade union 工会；the union of two countries 两国的联合

ex.en: The usual place was taken, so he sat by the window instead.
ex.cn: 平常那个位置有人了，他只好坐到窗边。
ex.note: as usual 和往常一样；the usual suspect 惯犯

ex.en: A veteran engineer of sixty showed him around the site.
ex.cn: 一位六十岁的老工程师带他在工地里转了一圈。
ex.note: a war veteran 退伍老兵；veteran workers 老工人

ex.en: When he stood up, his voice was thin and unsteady.
ex.cn: 站起来的时候，他的声音又细又不稳。
ex.note: raise one's voice 提高嗓门；the active voice 主动语态

ex.en: Several engineers voiced their worries about the plan.
ex.cn: 几位工程师表达了他们对这项计划的担忧。
ex.note: voice an opinion 表达意见；voice support for 表示支持

ex.en: His mother sent him a candle and a box of wax.
ex.cn: 母亲寄给他一支蜡烛和一盒蜡。
ex.note: candle wax 烛蜡；melt away 融化

ex.en: The road up the hill was wet and slippery after the rain.
ex.cn: 雨后上山的路又湿又滑。
ex.note: wet weather 潮湿的天气；soaked wet 湿透

ex.en: The spray wet his coat all the way to the office.
ex.cn: 一路上的水雾把他的外套全打湿了。
ex.note: wet oneself 尿湿；wet the bed 尿床

ex.en: He checked every width and every joint on the drawings.
ex.cn: 他把图纸上的每一处宽度和每一个接口都核对了一遍。
ex.note: a width of … …的宽度；the width of the tree 树的粗细

ex.en: The new pump does not work well in cold water.
ex.cn: 这台新水泵在冷水里运转不太好。
ex.note: work at 努力做；work out 算出；work for 为…工作

ex.en: On Fridays the whole department ate together after work.
ex.cn: 每个周五，整个部门下班后都一起吃饭。
ex.note: be at work 在工作；a work of art 一件艺术品

ex.en: Someone yelled over the noise of the engine.
ex.cn: 有人在发动机的轰鸣中大声喊叫。
ex.note: yell for help 大声呼救；a yell of pain 痛苦的叫声
